Fix issue #3: Add visual dimming effect for non-focused panes in the dashboard. When multiple agent panes are tiled, the non-active panes should have dimmed text to make it clear which pane has focus.

Implementation approach:
1. Create scripts/dashboard_dim.sh that toggles dimming on/off
2. Use tmux pane styling: set inactive pane style with dimmed fg color. The tmux options are:
   - tmux set-option -g window-style "fg=colour245,bg=default" (dim inactive)
   - tmux set-option -g window-active-style "fg=colour255,bg=default" (bright active)
3. Add keybinding: prefix+g t → toggle dim on/off via run-shell dashboard_dim.sh
4. Store toggle state in tmux option @tmuxagents-dim (on/off), default off
5. When toggling off, reset both window-style and window-active-style to default
6. Update README.md with the new t keybinding

Note: This affects ALL tmux panes globally (tmux limitation). Document this. Branch: feat/issue-3-visual-effect. Closes #3.
